title: PRESS + PULL
why: 6h sleep and tired legs, but you want to push — so the intensity goes upper body and pulling (clean & press ladders, renegade rows, snatches) while your legs and joints get a low-impact incline walk instead of hard running. Cleans and snatches are hip-driven, so they spare the quads. You still go hard, just not where you're beat up.

blocks.title: WARM-UP
blocks.text: Brisk walk 2 min · Band/stick dislocates ×10 · Scap push-ups ×10 · Halos 5/side · T-spine rotations 5/side · 5 light single cleans/side · 10 easy swings (16 kg).

blocks.title: THE GIANT
blocks.text: One ladder = 1 clean+press, then 2, then 3, 4, 5 (rest as needed between rungs). Then start over at 1. As many ladders as you can in 11 min. Clean is the pull, press overhead; legs just stabilize. Heavy and crisp, 1–2 in reserve.

blocks.title: PUSH / PULL CHAIN
blocks.text: Flow through all four back to back, minimal rest, then rest ~45s and repeat for 4 rounds. Brace hard on the rows so your hips don't rock. All upper + hip drive, no squatting.

blocks.title: SNATCH LADDER
blocks.workRest: go fast, rest only as needed
blocks.text: Descending ladder, both sides each round: 10/side, then 8, 6, 4, 2. Hip snap, punch through, land soft. High output, minimal legs. Empty the tank.

blocks.title: FLUSH WALK
blocks.text: Deliberate low-impact. Brisk incline walk to flush the legs and keep the calorie burn up without pounding tired quads. Breathe easy, you can hold a conversation.

blocks.title: COOLDOWN
blocks.text: Stretch 20–30s each: chest/shoulders (doorway), lats, hip flexors, quads (gentle), spinal twist.
